title: contract_identity_attestation_request
description: CI attestation envelope (L1_GOVERNANCE §2.2; per L0 §9.3.1 canonical-bytes). Substrate emits; Cultivator verifies + co-signs per L1_GOVERNANCE §2.3. Anchor-nonce bound to (mutation_hash, dag_tip_hash); TTL default 5 anchor-min.

enumerated_dag_nodes_since_last_co_sign.description: All DAG node hashes added since prior co-sign (not summary diff); enables Merkle-chain closure check per L0 §9.3.6 + §9.2.2.

proposed_mutation_canonical_bytes.description: Canonical-bytes per §9.3.1; substrate emits, Cultivator renders (substrate does not render).

operator_signing_key_public.description: From current handshake; cross-checked vs anchor-logged handshake by Cultivator.

request_timestamp_substrate_cycles.description: Per L0 §13.1 substrate-cycle authority for within-substrate ordering.

anchor_surface_nonce.description: Single-use nonce bound at step 1 of L1_GOVERNANCE §2.2 to (mutation_hash, dag_tip_hash); minted by anchor not substrate.

wall_clock_seconds_max.description: Anchor wall-clock expiry (L1-tunable). Whichever first invalidates wins (substrate cannot extend wall-clock via cycle throttle).
